offering_description.value: Deere designs and manufactures farm, turf, construction, roadbuilding, and forestry equipment for growers, landowners, contractors, and public agencies. It sells equipment and replacement parts mainly through dealers and provides precision technology, equipment financing, and leasing.

primary_products.value: farm machinery; lawn and turf equipment; construction and roadbuilding machinery; forestry machinery; engines and replacement parts

primary_services.value: equipment financing and leasing; precision agriculture data services; fleet monitoring

customer_segment.value: B2B: Farmers, agricultural contractors, landscapers, golf courses, construction and roadbuilding contractors, forestry operators, and equipment manufacturers; B2C: Homeowners and acreage owners buying lawn tractors, mowers, and compact tractors; B2G: Municipalities, transportation departments, and public land management agencies

end_markets.value: agriculture; commercial turf and residential lawn care; construction and roadbuilding; forestry; industrial equipment manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: New machinery, replacement parts, engines, and equipment components; interest or premiums: Interest on equipment purchase loans and dealer inventory financing; rental or leasing: Lease payments on farm, turf, construction, and forestry equipment; subscription: Recurring access to select precision technology features
revenue_model.category: product sales; interest or premiums; rental or leasing; subscription

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds finished machinery from purchased and in-house components for growers, contractors, property owners, and public agencies; component supplier: Makes engines and drivetrain components for other equipment manufacturers; financial intermediary: Funds equipment purchases, leases, and dealer inventory; software / platform: Uses machine and field data to provide precision farming and fleet management tools to equipment operators
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; financial intermediary; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania

specialization.value: related lines: Farm and turf, construction and roadbuilding, and forestry machinery, with related components, precision technology, and equipment finance

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent equipment dealers and distributors that sell machinery and parts and arrange financing; online: Company and dealer websites for parts ordering and digital platforms for precision technology

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Off-road engine emissions under EPA and EU standards, machinery safety requirements, and consumer lending rules
